company.name: JIO Technologies LLC

company.positioning: One supplier for both IT and power, so there is one contract and one support number instead of separate IT and power contractors.

company.careers: JIO is hiring in Abu Dhabi; see the Careers page. It looks for people who are passionate, proactive, team players, adaptable and committed. Open positions are listed on its recruitment portal.

services.name: Power and energy
services.summary: UPS systems, VRLA and lithium-ion batteries, and renewable energy setups, with installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, battery replacement and annual service contracts in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
services.details: Online UPS conditions power continuously and carries the load through an outage. VRLA batteries are the lower-cost, long-standing choice but shorter-lived in hot rooms. Lithium-ion batteries have a smaller footprint, better heat tolerance and a longer life, at a higher purchase price. Smart infrastructure and sustainability covers measuring and managing power use, IT performance and environmental impact together.

services.name: Data center design and hosting
services.summary: Design, build and management of data centers, from a single rack to an enterprise hall, including construction, cabling, power integration and cooling, plus secure hosting for critical applications.

services.name: Cloud and hybrid infrastructure
services.summary: Private, public or hybrid cloud environments designed, deployed and managed on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud.

services.name: Cybersecurity and data protection
services.summary: Security for digital assets with continuous monitoring and proactive threat detection.

services.name: Network and connectivity
services.summary: End-to-end networking from setup to optimisation: LAN and WAN design, wireless connectivity, and network security for hybrid workplaces.

services.name: CCTV and physical security
services.summary: Camera and recorder installation, remote monitoring, and integration with the IT network.

services.name: Managed IT and infrastructure
services.summary: The whole IT estate managed from servers to end-user support, so the client's own team is not tied up in daily maintenance.

services.name: Maintenance and 24/7 technical support
services.summary: Round-the-clock monitoring, preventive maintenance, remote and onsite help, and emergency response.

services.name: IT consulting and digital transformation
services.summary: IT planning, cloud migration and technology integration tied to the business plan.

services.name: IT procurement and vendor management
services.summary: Networking equipment, servers, storage, UPS units and power distribution units supplied through JIO.

faq.q: What services does JIO provide in the UAE?
faq.a: Hybrid IT and energy services: managed IT, power backup, cybersecurity, cloud, data center design, networking and technology procurement, in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

faq.q: Do you support small and large businesses?
faq.a: Yes. We work with SMEs, enterprises, government bodies and industrial clients, and scale each solution to the organisation.
Manufacturing, construction, healthcare, finance, retail, education, logistics, energy and utilities, and government.

Organisations that cannot afford downtime: government and the public sector, healthcare, banking and finance, energy and utilities, and industrial sites. What they share is critical IT that depends on reliable power, which is where one supplier for both helps most.
Yes: round-the-clock monitoring, remote and onsite help, and emergency response.

faq.q: Which brands do you work with?
faq.a: Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Cisco, Microsoft, APC, Eaton, Vertiv, Intel, Acronis and Ubiquiti, among others.

faq.q: Do you install and maintain UPS systems in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?
faq.a: Yes: installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, battery replacement and annual service contracts.

faq.q: Can you design and build data centers?
faq.a: Yes, end to end: construction, hosting, cabling, power integration and cooling, for small to enterprise environments.

faq.q: Do you offer CCTV and physical security?
faq.a: Yes: camera and recorder installation, remote monitoring, and integration with your IT network.

faq.q: Can you supply IT hardware and power equipment?
faq.a: Yes: networking equipment, servers, storage, UPS units, power distribution units and energy-efficient hardware.
IT and energy under one roof, end-to-end delivery, fast local support, and a focus on reliability and long-term partnerships.
